scientific_snapshot_policy: Freeze science and grading before external model runs. Changes after responses require a new version, except documented infrastructure repairs.

prompt_only_pilots.reason: No external model evaluation API is available in this environment. Scientific controls are not model attempts.

qualification_rule: At least three of five fresh ModelEvaluate graders must explicitly return FAIL. Local controls do not establish qualification.
platform_import_status: Pending external upload; package-side exact path, slot, schema, and hash preflight only.

cross_runtime.note: Attaining witnesses and choices may differ when they meet the physical endpoint and regret limits.

generation.method: Default generator reproduces every public data file byte-for-byte in a clean staged copy.
